en.reason: The current EN implementation is not a complete or reliable canonical mirror and exposes stale locale content. Canonical-mirror designation is retained, but public activation is held pending rebuild and Human Gate re-approval.

fr.reason: The current FR pilot is a reduced landing implementation rather than a parity translation of the canonical WPA Home and Institute. Public-pilot activation is held pending rebuild and Human Gate re-approval.

quality_hold.basis: Human Authority quality rejection of the current English and French public implementations.
quality_hold.effect: Fail-closed public exposure: Macedonian remains the only active public language until EN is rebuilt as the canonical mirror and FR is separately re-approved as a public pilot.

alignment.metadata_policy: data/languages.json is a superset metadata catalog; entries must resolve to canonical, reserve or compatibility-alias codes and do not imply public activation.
alignment.wave1_policy: French remains a Wave-1 candidate but its public-pilot activation is suspended pending a full parity rebuild and a new Human Gate decision. Every other Wave-1 language remains non-public.
alignment.english_policy: English retains canonical-mirror designation but its current public route is suspended until it is rebuilt from the Macedonian canonical master without stale commercial, credential or legacy identity content.
alignment.deletion_policy: No translator engine, loader, locale, language metadata entry or draft route may be deleted without zero-consumer evidence, dedicated CI and a separate reviewed pull request.
